mentions.name: Jelly Star slide-up gamepad mod
mentions.description: A hardware modification that adds a slide-up game controller to the Unihertz Jelly Star mini phone, turning it into an Xperia Play-style gaming device. The author is designing a sliding insert between the phone body and screen in FreeCAD; the controller board connects to the phone over Bluetooth (no usable internal bus for USB) and draws power from the phone's battery. The goal is to play games like Mina the Hollower on the tiny phone.
mentions.source_excerpt: Turning my Unihertz Jelly Star into an Xperia Play like device. Basically I want to add a slide up controller to this tiny phone.
